notes.title: Divine Birds arrives NOW!
notes.content:
Tons of new, FREE content

- New Divine Bird cards
- New runes exclusive to those cards
- New bosses you need to defeat to get each card
- A region with new areas (Eden York)
- A new final boss in the new region

Also, the game is available on Switch too now!
